hello.speaker: bailiff
hello.text: The tribunal hears only what can be entered into the record. Anger is not evidence, however deserved.

choices.text: [Succubus Spittle] Offer a brief kiss; use the contact to charm him.
Ask about the history of this place.

plain.speaker: bailiff
plain.text: The court notice beside the entrance grants you the right to question me.

alternative.speaker: bailiff
alternative.text: I will not risk my livelihood on a stranger’s word. Bring evidence. You can still learn what you need without changing my mind.

document.speaker: bailiff
document.text: That record settles it. No favour owed.

information.speaker: bailiff
information.text: The archlord’s envoy cannot contradict the original grant while the counterseal is displayed. Present the limits of delegation, then the living witness’s testimony.

charmed.speaker: bailiff
charmed.text: His reserve softens for this conversation. The archlord’s envoy cannot contradict the original grant while the counterseal is displayed. Present the limits of delegation, then the living witness’s testimony. The warmth fades as you part. Nothing here binds him to silence or loyalty.

resisted.speaker: bailiff
resisted.text: He draws away. “That felt like more than a greeting. Speak plainly if you want something.” The attempt fails; ordinary conversation and the evidence route remain open.

lore.speaker: bailiff
lore.text: The archlord’s collectors turned help into debt. A meal became a favour, a favour became an oath, and every oath acquired a clause its signer had never seen. Some of us learned not to ask questions. That habit has lasted longer than the fear that taught it.
